title: Ice skating is learned in small, definite steps, which makes it easier to start
alt: A smooth outdoor rink at dusk, a small ice resurfacer at the far end, bare trees behind the boards.

posts.facebook:
Ice skating is built in small steps, which is why the national programmes are set out in levels. Skate UK is taught at more than 40 rinks across Britain, and Learn to Skate USA has an adult curriculum of six levels. Many adult beginners' courses include skate hire: bring gloves, thin socks and warm layers.

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/learn-to-ice-skate/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
